_doc: clinic-spoken-word — consent for a person with no hands and no camera (2026-09-03).
The agent holds a slot; the dock shows a word the page never speaks and never hands to a tool, and
accepts a clean 'yes' too. 'Listen for me' hears it. A real microphone cannot be driven headlessly, so
the ?test=1 seam window.__cedarfieldHear(text) delivers a final sentence exactly where the recognizer
would; the routing after it is what this case proves: a request is queued, a negated yes is refused,
the word (or a clean yes) books, and the booking sentence never reaches the request queue.

eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-slot-state="open"]'); window.__slot = el && el.getAttribute('data-clinic-slot'); return typeof window.__slot; })()

_doc: Before a hold, the only word on screen is the grant card's, and the grant is a standing offer, not a question: a stray 'yes' grants nothing and is an ordinary request for the agent.
The agent holds the slot; the dock arms with a word (visual only) and the spoken road named.
